gaps.explanation: Statement transfers in 572,926 = Fire Department 571,055 + Other Governmental Funds 1,871 (p5); General column prints its net (572,926) out. The General Fund combining schedule by department (p15) prints department transfers gross: Economic Development 20,050 + Building 4,826 + Police 235,463 + Library 184,657 + Park 47,463 + Pool 44,270 = 536,729 in; General (538,598) + Hospital (571,057) = (1,109,655) out. Detail in = 536,729 + 571,055 + Hoferer Trust 1,871 (p19) = 1,109,655; gap 536,729 = intra-General-Fund department transfers netted in the statement's General column. No fix.

Statement p5 General column transfers out (572,926). Schedule p15: General (538,598) + Hospital (571,057) = (1,109,655) out, of which 536,729 goes to other General Fund departments (Economic Development 20,050, Building 4,826, Police 235,463, Library 184,657, Park 47,463, Pool 44,270). 1,109,655 - 536,729 = 572,926. No fix. (Detail indexes for General/Hospital carry original_label 'Transfers In' with negative amounts; the amounts are right, only the label reads 'In'.)

No business-type revenue is in detail[] (schedule_total 0). The modified cash proprietary funds statement (pp9-10) prints Sewer, Water and Sanitation columns and the trimmed PDF has no other utility schedule (the accrual statement of earlier years is not in this report's 19 pages; the all-funds budget schedule p13 mixes governmental and utility revenues). Added one line per printed non-zero row per fund column: Sewer 274,803 + 208 + 855 = 275,866; Water 395,193 + 12,149 + 2,090 + 40,147 = 449,579; Sanitation 135,494 + 761 = 136,255; total 861,700 = statement 818,608 + 2,945 + 40,147. 0 + 861,700 = 861,700.
